title: Planned move to a boarding facility in eastern New York

tellings.quote: was going to go to a facility in Eastern New York and I was going to live there full-time

plain: In 2010, Jordan Jose says, he was supposed to move to a facility in eastern New York and live there full-time. Jose, who says a UFO program took him as a child, tells Michels this about his own life: he "was going to go to a facility in Eastern New York." If true, it would mean the program planned to take over his childhood entirely.
